mapper.insert: INSERT INTO smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_req ( request_id, cmd_tp, cmd_msg, qos, retain_yn, status, total_targets, sent_cnt, ack_ok_cnt, ack_fail_cnt, frst_regist_dt, frst_user_id, frst_regist_tool ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{cmdTp}, #{cmdMsg}, #{qos}, #{retainYn}, 'CREATED', #{totalTargets}, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId}, #{tool} )

INSERT INTO smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target ( req_id, facility_id, msg_id, cmd_tp, cmd_msg, target_status, retry_cnt, frst_regist_dt, frst_user_id, frst_regist_tool, last_updt_dt ) VALUES ( #{reqId}, #{facilityId}, NULL, #{cmdTp}, #{cmdMsg}, 'PENDING', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId}, #{tool}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target SET msg_id = #{msgId}, last_updt_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target_id = #{targetId}

UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_req r JOIN ( SELECT req_id, COUNT(*) AS total_targets, SUM( CASE WHEN publish_dt IS NOT NULL OR target_status IN ('SENT','ACK_OK','ACK_FAIL','DEAD','EXPIRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS sent_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN target_status = 'ACK_OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ack_ok_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN target_status = 'ACK_FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ack_fail_cnt FROM smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target WHERE req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY req_id ) x ON r.req_id = x.req_id SET r.total_targets = x.total_targets, r.sent_cnt = x.sent_cnt, r.ack_ok_cnt = x.ack_ok_cnt, r.ack_fail_cnt = x.ack_fail_cnt WHERE r.req_id = #{reqId}

UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target SET target_status = 'SENDING', worker_id = #{workerId}, picked_dt = NOW(), last_updt_dt = NOW() WHERE target_id IN ( SELECT y.target_id FROM ( SELECT t.target_id FROM smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target t WHERE ( t.target_status = 'PENDING' OR ( t.target_status = 'RETRY' AND (t.next_retry_dt IS NULL OR t.next_retry_dt <= NOW()) ) ) AND ( t.worker_id IS NULL OR t.picked_dt IS NULL OR t.picked_dt < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{stuckSec} SECOND) ) ORDER BY t.target_id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize} ) y )

UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target SET target_status = 'RETRY', next_retry_dt = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{nextDelaySec} SECOND), last_error = #{error}, worker_id = NULL, picked_dt = NULL, last_updt_dt = NOW() WHERE target_status = 'SENDING' AND worker_id = #{workerId}

UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target SET target_status = 'SENT', publish_dt = NOW(), last_error = NULL, worker_id = NULL, picked_dt = NULL, last_updt_dt = NOW() WHERE target_id = #{targetId} AND target_status = 'SENDING' AND worker_id = #{workerId}

UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target SET retry_cnt = retry_cnt + 1, target_status = CASE WHEN (retry_cnt + 1) > #{maxRetry} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRY' END, next_retry_dt = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{nextDelaySec} SECOND), last_error = #{error}, worker_id = NULL, picked_dt = NULL, last_updt_dt = NOW() WHERE target_id = #{targetId} AND target_status = 'SENDING' AND worker_id = #{workerId}
mapper.select: SELECT target_id AS targetId, req_id AS reqId, facility_id AS facilityId, msg_id AS msgId, cmd_tp AS cmdTp, cmd_msg AS cmdMsg, target_status AS targetStatus, publish_dt AS publishDt, ack_dt AS ackDt, ack_code AS ackCode, ack_msg AS ackMsg, retry_cnt AS retryCnt, next_retry_dt AS nextRetryDt, worker_id AS workerId, picked_dt AS pickedDt, last_error AS lastError FROM smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target SET ack_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, target_status = CASE WHEN #{ok} = 1 THEN 'ACK_OK' ELSE 'ACK_FAIL' END, ack_code = #{ackCode}, ack_msg = #{ackMsg}, last_updt_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} AND ack_dt IS NULL AND target_status = 'SENT'
UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_req SET sent_cnt = sent_cnt + 1 WHERE req_id = #{reqId}
UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_req SET ack_ok_cnt = ack_ok_cnt + 1 WHERE req_id = #{reqId}
UPDATE smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_req SET ack_fail_cnt = ack_fail_cnt + 1 WHERE req_id = #{reqId}
mapper.select: SELECT req_id AS reqId, request_id AS requestId, cmd_tp AS cmdTp, cmd_msg AS cmdMsg, qos AS qos, retain_yn AS retainYn, status AS status, total_targets AS totalTargets, sent_cnt AS sentCnt, ack_ok_cnt AS ackOkCnt, ack_fail_cnt AS ackFailCnt, frst_regist_dt AS frstRegistDt, frst_user_id AS frstUserId, frst_regist_tool AS frstRegistTool FROM smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_req WHERE req_id = #{reqId}

SELECT t.target_id AS targetId, t.req_id AS reqId, t.facility_id AS facilityId, t.msg_id AS msgId, t.cmd_tp AS cmdTp, t.cmd_msg AS cmdMsg,
r.retain_yn AS retainYn, r.qos AS qos,
t.target_status AS targetStatus, t.publish_dt AS publishDt, t.ack_dt AS ackDt, t.ack_code AS ackCode, t.ack_msg AS ackMsg, t.retry_cnt AS retryCnt, t.next_retry_dt AS nextRetryDt, t.worker_id AS workerId, t.picked_dt AS pickedDt, t.last_error AS lastError FROM smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_target t JOIN smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility_cmd_req r ON r.req_id = t.req_id WHERE t.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY t.target_id ASC
